messages.subject: Shiny App can't read files from /home directory
parts:
Hi, 

My simple shiny app. reads and displays data from a csv file. The file was first kept in the shiny app.'s folder. After keeping getting permission denied error, I move the csv file to my home directory. It still kept throwing the same error. Eventually, I moved the file under root /, which is not ideal, but that's the only way at this stage I can get shiny to read the csv file. 

I have tried various permission settings on the csv file as well. It has 777 and owner and group is shiny:shiny. Of course, the original owner is myself and that didn't work. 

Can anyone shed some light on the issue please? Thanks in advance. 


Eva
